# NextXus YAML Data Hub

The Federation data schemas explained as a readable reference. It covers the "everything is the same" uniform schema — the shared shape every Federation record follows — and the 13-topic taxonomy (v1.1) laid out as a readable table.

## Source data (transferred from keyhole-creator)

Canonical YAML and notes previously held under the keyhole-creator account have been transferred into the `source/` directory of this repository so the account is self-contained:

### Core YAML
- `source/directives.yaml` — the 70 Sacred Directives
- `source/federation.yaml` — historical site registry (many older Replit/Tiiny links marked historical; prefer current GitHub Pages sovereign mirrors)

### Additional transferred material (`source/transferred/`)
- `nextxus-evolution-README.md` — SOE-v1 notes
- `NEXTXUS_MASTER_MAP.yaml` — pillar and identity map (Emergent preview URLs historical)
- `NexusForge-BaseModel-README.md` — Forge base model overview

`keyhole-creator/nextxus-core` remains a large full-stack TypeScript app (client/server/database dump). It has not been fully mirrored here; its key notes can be extracted on request.
